significance.justification: A verified-true result would establish a form-(iii) predictive coupling—at a branch cue, the residual stream has "already represented the competing approaches and a preference among them," and that state predicts the eventual winning branch—combined with the form-(ii) claim that suppressing predicted losing branches preserves the answer. This would establish both a phenomenon, serially verbalized alternatives being precommitted internally, and a mechanism fixing when branch selection occurs; it would predict that many apparent exploratory continuations are dispensable rather than merely showing that some reasoning tokens are redundant. Refutation would also be informative by favoring genuinely sequential discovery or verification during generation, although words such as "frequently" and "minimal accuracy loss" leave the quantitative boundary somewhat underspecified; true and false nevertheless describe distinguishable worlds. SOTA work on external search and test-time computation, including Tree of Thoughts (Yao et al., 2023) and Snell et al.'s test-time-compute scaling study (2024), makes the timing of branch commitment consequential; after topic substitution, generic efficient-reasoning importance would not retain this score, whereas the specific pre-verbalization predictive relation does.

reach.justification: The named handles are a probe on "residual-stream hidden states at the branch cue token" and a "branch-pruning controller" that redirects or commits before a predicted losing continuation is generated. This is ex ante rather than post hoc: the reading occurs "before it is generated," leaving an action window in which inference tokens and latency can be avoided. After per-model re-extraction, the substantive hypothesis still predicts the same coupling—branch-point state forecasts eventual commitment—rather than supplying only an unstructured search procedure; its asserted scope covers reasoning models and multiple reasoning-task classes, with deployment and inference-system practitioners as plausible downstream users. The topic-substitution check lowers no further because efficient reasoning alone supplies neither this advance warning nor this gating handle; those claim-specific features satisfy the lead-time and non-researcher-uptake criteria, though cue dependence and per-setting calibration keep the reach below the highest band.
